verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a done-for-you incorporation and back-office service. Its core offering is registered agent services, state filings, agency notifications, a dedicated bookkeeper and mail handling, all performed by the company and its partners. These are legally licensed, human-delivered services rather than deployable software, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable distribution exists.
